text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while observing training at the pool...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right! Turbo's gonna show you
that I'm fast in the water too!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna lose either~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Realizing I couldn't just let them fool around
by the poolside, I was about to call out when...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Turbo-san, Tannhauser-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Before swimming, you must properly perform
your warm-up exercises.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Turbo's always full throttle,
even without a warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely. Diving into the pool without preparation
will rapidly cool down your body.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By doing light exercises, you improve blood circulation,
warm up your joints and muscles, and significantly enhance—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A-All right! Turbo'll do the warm-ups properly!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: M-Me too...! One, two! Three, four!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having finished their warm-ups,
the three lined up by the poolside...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, what training are we doing today again?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I have prepared two training plans.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First is a routine centered on long-distance swimming and
no-breath streamlines to build the cardiopulmonary function
necessary for enduring front-running tactics...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The other focuses on kick-based drills designed
to strengthen the leg power mainly needed
for late-charging tactics.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Now, which plan shall we proceed with?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Front-runner, obviously!
I want the training that's perfect for Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'd prefer late charging~.
I want to boost my explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hmm, opinions are divided...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san over there.
Apologies, but could you provide your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We are struggling to decide which training
routine we should execute...
choice_data_list: Train stamina and specialize in front-running!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
The perfect training for Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin with streamlines
without taking a breath.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Don't really get it, but all I gotta do
is hold my breath for a super long time, right!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna set a new record~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, amazing!
You really did break the record~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, she doesn't look like she's coming up at all...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Turbo-san!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? My head is spinning around and around...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...B-But! Turbo set a new record...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
True, that is a fact.
There was something gained from this...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, overexertion is strictly forbidden!
Your physical health takes priority over records.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We shall conclude today's training here.
We are going to the nurse's office just in case.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Watch this! With the training Ikuno prepared,
I'm totally gonna step up my game!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tannhauser-san...
Diving in with that much momentum is—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SMACK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The area around Machikane Tannhauser as she floated
in the pool began turning red...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry.
I hit my face and got a nosebleed~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Continuing swim training under these conditions
appears impossible.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I intended to provide full support, but today
I shall devote my efforts to nursing you.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah, Turbo'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Turbo-san.
Now, let us head to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay~.
